metadata.title: Hola! I am back.
metadata.description:
Hi guys, welcome back to @Masterchefnambie. I have been missing from the vlogs scene for a whole year and this is my coming back video. 

I am really overwhelmed with the love and support that I got from you even when I was not actively posting videos. I plan on being consistent this year and look forward for the same kind of love and support you have given me. In case of any enquiries  you can always reach me through the comments section or through my facebook and instagram account by the same name eat your kappa or through email id eatyourkappa@gmail.com.
